name: Soulmates
source: "Soulmates" is a short story of the "Shadow-Trilogy", a novel series by Marcel Weyers. It takes place a few years before the first novel "Shadows" starts and introduces the main protagonist Haru and his best friend Yusaku. The novel is a short story about friendship and is set in a modern day Japanese village.
